native_height_range_role: Coverage guard only; API max is never subtracted or treated as a Java logical height. Native endpoint acceptance still requires the selected engine observation.

dismount_contract.scope: only the target rider before each attempt while still riding; never eject all riders

boundaries: Unknown/custom logical dimensions are unsupported; do not infer a vanilla identity from heightRange.
No Java ground search, blocksMotion/noCollision/no-liquid AABB equivalence, navigation stop or TELEPORT game event is added.
Randomness uses the same uniform distribution with Math.random; Java actor RNG sequences are not available.
Dismount and tryTeleport run only in mutable script context; API reads/writes and actual native rider state must be observed separately.
Native heightRange coverage is not proof of inclusive/exclusive endpoint convention or native collision semantics.
